The articles are organized around the way most users arrive at
`gamlss.longitudinal`: first learn the standard workflow, then go deeper on
inference, diagnostics, benchmarks, or migration from GEE and GLMM models.

## Start Here

Read these first if you want the shortest path from data to an interpretable
longitudinal model.

| Article | Use it for |
|---|---|
| `vignette("standard-workflow", package = "gamlss.longitudinal")` | The recommended screen, fit, check, infer, predict, and simulate workflow. |
| `vignette("native-simulation-workflow", package = "gamlss.longitudinal")` | A full simulated example with known truth, copula screening, fitting, and diagnostics. |

## Core Workflow Components

Use these when reviewing one part of an analysis.

| Article | Use it for |
|---|---|
| `vignette("inference-uncertainty", package = "gamlss.longitudinal")` | Confidence intervals, Wald tests, likelihood comparisons, bootstrap inference, and uncertainty language. |
| `vignette("diagnostics-decisions", package = "gamlss.longitudinal")` | `check_model()`, warnings, model-role recommendations, tail checks, and dependence diagnostics. |
| `vignette("benchmarking-adoption", package = "gamlss.longitudinal")` | Scenario-level benchmark evidence against GEE, GLMM, and GAM baselines. |
| `vignette("adoption-decision-guide", package = "gamlss.longitudinal")` | Deciding whether the model should be primary, sensitivity-only, or not used. |

## Migration From Familiar Models

Use these when starting from an existing GEE or GLMM habit.

| Article | Use it for |
|---|---|
| `vignette("replace-gee-glmm", package = "gamlss.longitudinal")` | A high-level translation from GEE/GLMM concepts to GAMLSS-copula concepts. |
| `vignette("replace-a-gee", package = "gamlss.longitudinal")` | Replacing a marginal mean GEE when distributional or dependence features matter. |
| `vignette("replace-a-random-intercept-glmm", package = "gamlss.longitudinal")` | Replacing a random-intercept GLMM when the random effect is mainly a dependence device. |

## Problem-Specific Guides

Use these for common applied wrinkles.

| Article | Use it for |
|---|---|
| `vignette("non-gaussian-longitudinal-outcomes", package = "gamlss.longitudinal")` | Positive, skewed, count, tail-sensitive, or otherwise non-Gaussian responses. |
| `vignette("missing-visits", package = "gamlss.longitudinal")` | Unbalanced panels, absent visits, and missingness-sensitive reporting. |
| `vignette("time-varying-dependence", package = "gamlss.longitudinal")` | Modelling changing longitudinal association with `theta.formula`. |

## Reference Pages

After reading an article, use the reference index for function-level details.
The reference pages are grouped into standard workflow, inference and
interpretation, diagnostics, simulation and benchmarks, and link helpers.
